definition: whether positions of elevated cross-group conservation exist in the RT domain at all
truth_source_or_none: the derivational alignment itself, against a residue-shuffle null
reason: 81 conserved columns in ALIGN_000044 and 82 in an independent MAFFT re-alignment of the same 66 proteins; the residue-shuffle null returns 0 in every one of 200 replicates (mean 0.00, max 0, empirical p=0.0050). A declared positive control and a declared null both exist and both behave.
allowable_claim: conserved positions exist in the RT domain and are not a compositional artefact
prohibited_phrasing: nothing beyond the derivation substrate; this is not a claim about Stage-1 sequences
denominator: 626 columns of the stated RT domain

definition: whether the conserved regions occur in a fixed linear order, and whether a detector reproduces that order on a query sequence
truth_source_or_none: the derivation alignment for the reference order; the query's own residue order for the test
reason: no region reorders between the two independent frames: the 7 frame-2 regions are an ordered refinement of the 6 frame-1 regions, produced by splitting one region. g3 independently finds the prior landmark ORDER preserved, with 27 of 28 prior landmark placements inside a g2 region and monotone in LtrA coordinates. Ordering is checkable on any query without external truth, because it is a property of the query's own residue numbering.
allowable_claim: ordered-architecture recovery rate: the fraction of inspectable query sequences on which the detector emits regions in the derivation order
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called accuracy; an ordered output is not a correct output
frame: LtrA residue coordinates, shared by both frames
denominator: 6 regions in frame 1 vs 7 in frame 2

candidate_quantity: localization of the catalytic dyad landmark
definition: residue offset between the observed catalytic [YF]xDD in a query sequence and the interval the detector predicts for the dyad-carrying region
truth_source_or_none: the query sequence itself - motif occurrence is determined by the residues, not by any model
evidence_source: g2_landmark_recovery.tsv H05; g2_positive_controls.tsv C1,C2; g3_prior_frame_correspondence.tsv block 23 YADDFVI
reason: this is the only landmark in the whole track whose position on an arbitrary query is determinable independently of any model, alignment or prior frame. g2 located it at ALIGN_000044 column 783 / LtrA residue 306 WITHOUT using it to place any boundary, so using it as a held-out check is not circular - conditional on the hard constraint that it never enters derivation, scoring or threshold selection (see derivation_allowlist.tsv, rule R-DYAD).
allowable_claim: landmark localization offset, in residues, with its distribution and its non-detection rate
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called boundary accuracy; locating one motif is not delimiting a region
denominator: sequences in the declared arm that carry a detectable [YF]xDD

definition: per (query sequence, region) call state from the declared vocabulary of launcher section 7a
truth_source_or_none: none for regions other than the dyad-carrying one
reason: for the dyad-carrying region a genuine event label exists on any query that carries the motif, so presence is checkable there. For every other region there is no label of any kind: nothing external states whether a given RT protein contains region 2 or region 6. Call-state DISTRIBUTIONS remain reportable, and non-detection is never read as biological absence.
allowable_claim: call-state distribution per region with inspectability retained; presence checking for the dyad-carrying region only
prohibited_phrasing: must not report presence accuracy, sensitivity or recall for any non-dyad region; must not read NOT_DETECTED as absence

definition: whether a predicted region interval falls in the expected position relative to an independently determinable anchor or to the same detector under perturbation
truth_source_or_none: partial - the dyad anchor, plus self-consistency
reason: approximate location is measurable in exactly two ways, and both are honest only under their own name: relative to the dyad (Q03), or as reproducibility across perturbation (Q10). It is NOT measurable against a stated correct location, because none exists.
allowable_claim: approximate localization relative to the catalytic dyad; or localization stability. Never both conflated.
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called localization accuracy without naming which of the two it is

definition: difference in residues between a predicted region start and the true region start
reason: no population supplies a true start. The derivation bundle itself declares edge_precision_claim=INTERVAL_ONLY for all six regions because the primary sources state a procedure and no residue edges. Start dispersion across the declared 150-setting sweep is 21, 54, 39, 58, 43 and 5 columns for regions 1-6. Blocker's LtrA M1-R85 / R86-R364 are the zone edges of a DIFFERENT two-way partition, not per-region starts, and PDB structures carry a different representation (fingers/palm/thumb) that launcher section 5d forbids substituting.
prohibited_phrasing: START_ACCURACY may not be reported, estimated, approximated or renamed
denominator: 150 parameter settings in the declared sweep

definition: difference in residues between a predicted region end and the true region end
reason: as Q06. End dispersion across the sweep is 24, 52, 47, 72, 41 and 3 columns for regions 1-6; the largest, 72 columns on region 4, is larger than four of the six regions are wide.
denominator: 150 parameter settings in the declared sweep

definition: joint correctness of a predicted region start and end against true boundaries
reason: BOUNDARY_ACCURACY = UNESTABLISHED. This is the load-bearing negative result of the redesign and it is declared before any method is chosen, not after one fails. The launcher's own g4 kill criterion already contemplates this outcome.
allowable_claim: the explicit declaration that boundary accuracy is unestablished, with the reason
prohibited_phrasing: no substitute metric may be computed and then called accuracy
denominator: n/a - the quantity has no denominator because it has no truth

definition: dispersion of inferred region edges across an ensemble of admissible derivational perturbations
truth_source_or_none: the perturbation ensemble itself, not biology
reason: the 150-setting parameter sweep and the second alignment frame are already landed and constitute two of the ensemble's axes; derivation-sequence bootstrap adds a third. The resulting interval is a property of the procedure and is named accordingly.
allowable_claim: operational_boundary_stability_interval, reported as median edge plus 50/90/95 percent empirical stability bands and a multimodal-placement flag
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called a 95 percent confidence interval on a true boundary, nor a credible interval, nor error bars on a boundary

definition: intersection-over-union of region intervals between the reference derivation and each perturbed derivation
reason: already instantiated once at n=2 frames: per-region cross-frame Jaccard on LtrA residues is 0.739, 1.000, 0.911, 0.410, 0.955 and 1.000, median 0.955. The measure is well defined, has a landed precedent, and separates stable regions from region 4 unambiguously.
allowable_claim: region-interval stability, per region, with the unstable regions named
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called validation, and must not be pooled into a single stability number that hides region 4

definition: fraction of inspectable query sequences at low sequence distance from the derivation set on which the detector produces an ordered, non-ambiguous localization containing the dyad where one is present
truth_source_or_none: none - this is a property of the instrument on a population
reason: a rate over a declared population with a declared denominator. It requires the identity/coverage matrix to be re-anchored on the 66 g2 derivation proteins rather than on all167, which is repair 3 from the failed review and is a bounded 66-by-N computation.
allowable_claim: transferability rate, stratified by nearest-derivation identity
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called accuracy, validation, or held-out performance
denominator: inspectable sequences in the identity stratum

definition: as Q11, restricted to sequences whose best identity to any derivation protein falls below a declared threshold with declared bidirectional coverage
reason: the same rate under a stricter stratum definition. Identity distance and family novelty are separate axes and are reported separately, never merged into one word.
allowable_claim: transferability rate at declared identity distance
prohibited_phrasing: must not be described as generalization to unseen RTs without also naming the family axis
denominator: inspectable sequences below the identity threshold

definition: as Q11, per Stage-1 family label
reason: measurable as a rate, but the standard framing is unavailable and must not be used. The derivation substrate is 66 group II intron ORFs in four lineage groups - mitochondrial 29, bacterial 20, algal/chloroplast 11, euglenoid 6. It contains no Stage-1 family label at all. There is therefore nothing to hold out: EVERY Stage-1 family is out-of-family by construction, and no family-held-out cross-validation split exists to be defined. What is measurable is per-family transferability with the derivation composition declared alongside it.
allowable_claim: per-family transferability with the derivation set's own composition stated in the same table
prohibited_phrasing: FAMILY_HELD_OUT and leave-family-out must not be used; there is no held-out split because there is no in-family training set
denominator: inspectable sequences of that family in the sample

definition: whether a sequence-defined region falls inside an independently defined structural feature
truth_source_or_none: partial - structural feature assignment, in a different representation
reason: at most 25 structures are usable: 26 PDB anchors minus LtrA/5G2X, which is the coordinate carrier of the whole track and cannot be both ruler and test. Three further limits are recorded and not argued away: 7 anchors carry His6, 1 SUMO, 3 thrombin and 1 Strep tags, so native numbering must be restored before any residue comparison (open item U11); 10 of the 26 overlap the ph38 re-scan panel and the set is structure-conditioned; and fingers/palm/thumb is a DIFFERENT representation that launcher section 5d forbids using to manufacture the sequence partition. What survives is a containment question.
allowable_claim: structural correspondence: whether the predicted dyad-carrying region lies within the palm, and whether region order corresponds to structural order
prohibited_phrasing: must not be called independent validation, ground truth, or boundary confirmation; must not be used to adjudicate any region edge
frame: PDB entries admitted to the arm
denominator: structures remaining after LtrA exclusion and tag-offset resolution

definition: agreement between a predicted presence probability and observed presence frequency
truth_source_or_none: partial - the dyad event label only
reason: calibration needs event labels. Exactly one event has labels on arbitrary sequences: does the query carry a detectable catalytic [YF]xDD inside the predicted region. That single event can be calibrated on a declared population. No other region has any label, so no other calibration curve can be drawn.
allowable_claim: PRESENCE_CALIBRATION, for the dyad-carrying region only, named with the population it was demonstrated on
prohibited_phrasing: the word calibrated may not appear next to any other region, nor next to a pooled all-region number

definition: agreement between a predicted boundary-correctness probability and observed boundary correctness
reason: BOUNDARY_CALIBRATION = UNESTABLISHED, and necessarily so: calibration of a boundary requires boundary labels, which Q08 establishes do not exist. A score margin, a posterior from a profile model or a bootstrap width may not be relabelled as a boundary-correctness probability.
allowable_claim: the explicit declaration that boundary calibration is unestablished
prohibited_phrasing: no heuristic score margin may be presented as a boundary confidence
denominator: n/a - the quantity has no denominator because it has no truth
